items.summary: New tools/check-event-guards.mjs, wired into npm run check after check-actionbar (check-pipeline passes). It uses the TypeScript parser on every pack script and tools/*-shared.js. For each onScriptEvent with literal ids (or a const array), it checks (1) that every id the handler compares with (===/!==/switch case) is registered, and (2) that every top-level `if (id !== a && ...) return;` guard, including as one part of an `||`, lets through every registered id still reaching it (minus ids that earlier `if (id === x) {...return}` branches took). The inner guards stay in place, and the check stops them from drifting. WORKING.md C29 row mentions it.

items.summary: expedition_bp saves the line in `expedition:queue` and restores it on worldLoad. After a reload, online leaders are told they are still number N of M. After a restart, an offline leader keeps the place for 5 minutes (QUEUE_REJOIN) and is told on rejoin. Reviewer fix: a server stop disconnects everyone first, and the leave handler used to dequeue and save at once, which emptied the saved line just before the restart. Now a leave only marks the leader (queueLeft, in-memory queueGone). The 100-tick pump drops them once QUEUE_GONE (200 ticks) has passed, so any pump in the shutdown window saves the line with them still in it. A leader who reconnects sooner keeps the place silently. dequeue and clearQueue clear the marks. system.beforeEvents.shutdown is in 2.1.0, but it fires after players have left, and its before-event (read-only) can't save, so the grace is the fix. PACKS.md queue text updated.

The wiring regex that pinned `dequeue(playerId)` in the leave handler now pins `queueLeft(playerId)`, and the new behavior tests prove that leaving still drops the party. New BDS scenario tools/test-bds/examples/expedition-queue-restart.js uses t.restart() and the new probe hook tools/test-bds/hooks/expedition-queue-rejoin.mjs (it reads the pack's saved line and moves a restored entry onto the leader's new id, the way milestones-rejoin does). decisions: Finding 1 (F32 legacy tf:1) is real. Fixed with a new key `tc` instead of `tf: 2`: `tf` stays 1 on confirmed records, so older pack versions (which read tf) still skip the backfill, and every existing assertion `record.tf === 1` holds. Fixtures that stand for a confirmed record got `tc: 1`.
The test report's `tf` field (pack recordReport and the milestones-rejoin hook) now reports confirmation (`tc`). The W10 flag scenario asks exactly that, and its assertions are unchanged.

Finding 2 (F28 restart) is real as a risk. Fixed with a leave grace (QUEUE_GONE 200 ticks; the pump drops the party, not the leave). system.beforeEvents.shutdown exists in 2.1.0 but fires after players have left and is read-only, so it can't save. Wrote a t.restart() BDS scenario with a probe hook that remaps the leader's id, as the reviewer asked. Not run: TIMING_SOAK_RUNNING.

Replaced the expedition wiring regex that pinned `dequeue(playerId)` on leave with `queueLeft(playerId)`. Behavior tests prove leaving still drops the party, after 10 s. The old pin described the mechanism the fix removes.

Finding 3 (tamer watch replaced by another tap) is real. One watch per (animal, player). Ambiguity records nobody: a wrongly granted pet is worse than the pre-F29 locked state. My own earlier 'last feeder gets it' test codified the reviewer's case 2. It is replaced by a test with a wild check between the feeds.
Finding 4 (championHurt guard) is real: dead code, removed. The other F22 guards stay.

Finding 5 (NEWS.md) is not acted on in the branch: the brief forbids editing NEWS.md (the integrator writes it from newsLines). Player-facing lines for F28, F29 and F31 (plus F30, F32) are in newsLines, and gen-news is listed in generatorsNeeded.
Finding 6 (F19 unmeasured) is real but can't be done now: TIMING_SOAK_RUNNING. The exact before/after profile commands are in bdsPending. F19 is not claimed as a perf gain until measured.

No manifest bumps in these commits: every touched pack (milestones 1.0.7, expedition 2.4.13, claims 1.5.8, elite 1.3.13, tornado 1.2.11, cooking 1.1.14, titles 1.2.12, mail 1.2.8) is already one above origin/master 5422aac on this base, so check-versions passes, and diag.js already carries those versions.

newsLines: Land Claims: your own pets now work in other people's claims too. A wolf, cat or parrot you feed tame, or a horse you ride tame, can be leashed, ridden or told to sit by you anywhere. Pets tamed before this update stay locked in others' claims.
Kitchen: old dishes from before the Dish: line now stack with new servings once they are in your inventory or when you join.
Expeditions: the line for a dungeon now survives a reload or a restart. Leaders are told they're still number N of M, and after a restart you have 5 minutes to come back and keep your place.
Milestones: top-tier titles you missed while Titles & Trails was off are now sent again until Titles confirms them.
Realm Mail: a pack letter refused because the realm's mail is full no longer deletes your oldest letters.
risks: F28 leave grace: a leader who leaves stays in the line for up to 10 s plus one 100-tick pump (about 15 s), but the start loop skips offline leaders, so no party is held up. If BDS shows the leave event does not fire on shutdown, the grace is only defense in depth.
F29: when two players feed the same animal within the same window, nobody is recorded and the pet stays locked in others' claims (documented).

F32: on the first join after this update, every player who already had tf=1 gets their top-tier titles sent once more. Titles ignores titles a player already owns, so it adds a few script events per such player and no duplicate titles.
All BDS proofs and the F19 perf numbers are still pending (CODE-ONLY mode during the timing soak). npm run check has not been run on this branch since the reviewer fixes.

The op check runs again on submit, and the copy is read again in case another operator acted. (N11) the retired welcome:profile key is deleted once per load, also in worlds that migrated earlier. (N12) the story start line names only the prologue givers who are placed.
